detail.longDescription: "Transparency in Agentic AI: A Survey of Interpretability, Explainability, and Governance" synthesizes methods for LLM agents across the full lifecycle. Key result: a five-axis taxonomy and the Minimal Explanation Packet (MEP) for trajectory-level auditability. # AgenticAI # XAI # Interpretability # AIGovernance https:// vectorinstitute.github.io/Agen tic-Transparency/
